author: jcelis
quote: A very good game—better than *Ocarina* on the great N64. It’s a full-fledged remake in terms of technical aspects and gameplay, and the 60fps performance adds an extra bonus; it’s easily the best game on the NSW2 so far.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: jcelis
quote: I bought this version of the game and I deeply regret it; the story is terrible and "woke," the bugs are unacceptable, and don't even get me started on the unstable performance—with drops below 20 fps and a 30 fps cap. I’ll wait for the PC version to see if these issues get fixed.
